scheme_name: She Means Business – Digital Skills for Women
overview: She Means Business – Digital Skills for Women is a global initiative by Meta (Facebook) aimed at empowering women entrepreneurs through digital skills training, mentorship, and networking opportunities. The program focuses on helping women start, grow, and scale their businesses using digital tools and platforms. It provides free online courses, community support, and access to resources tailored to women-led enterprises.
objectives: Empower women entrepreneurs with digital skills
Support women in starting and growing their businesses
Provide access to mentorship and peer networks
Enable use of digital tools for business growth
Foster inclusive economic participation of women
eligibility: Open to women entrepreneurs, aspiring business owners, and women-led small businesses seeking to enhance their digital capabilities and grow their ventures through online platforms.
benefits: Free digital skills training, access to online learning modules, mentorship opportunities, community networking, tools for business promotion on Meta platforms, and guidance on leveraging social media for growth.
financial_support: The program does not provide direct financial support, grants, loans, or subsidies. It focuses on non-financial capacity building through training and mentorship.
application_process: 1. Visit the She Means Business Facebook page or website. 2. Sign up or register for the program using a Facebook account. 3. Access free online courses and training modules. 4. Participate in community events and webinars. 5. Apply learned digital skills to grow your business.
deadlines: Rolling basis — no fixed deadline. Registration and learning are open year-round.
caveats: Program is delivered primarily through Facebook and Meta platforms
No financial assistance or funding is provided
Requires access to internet and a Facebook/Meta account to participate
